keyDecisions: Use Context.Service and explicit root-composed Layers.
Use named Effect.fn for reusable effectful functions and Effect.gen for effect values and local orchestration.
Use Schema.TaggedError for stable expected boundary failures while preserving interruption.
Own resources with Layers and Scopes at the narrowest correct lifetime.
Default to forkChild or scoped fibers; detached work requires explicit host ownership.
Use Clock and DateTime for testable time and explicit zones; use a project-owned versioned PRNG for durable replay.
Use one distinct runtime owner for each browser window, service worker, Bun compiler, future Cloudflare Worker, and test root.
Use BrowserRuntime.runMain for the initial interactive page and BunRuntime.runMain for the compiler.
Use ManagedRuntime only at repeated JavaScript-to-Effect boundaries and always give it one disposal owner.
Keep browser storage and network implementations app-local.
Deploy static assets without a Cloudflare Worker until a concrete server responsibility exists.
Pin all Effect ecosystem packages to one exact matching v4 version through the Bun root catalog.
